item.title: Report: 2026 NFLPA report card shows Bengals drop in overall team rankings
item.description: The NFL won a grievance earlier this year that prevented the NFLPA from releasing the report card. Still, ESPN obtained the results, which grade teams A+ through F- on various categories.

item.title: Students, faculty to protest Millett Hall demolition and replacement ahead of key vote
item.description: A university proposal to demolish Millett Hall and build a new facility on what's now Cooks Field in the center of campus has drawn criticism from some in Oxford.

item.title: Sharon Woods renovation delayed, lake area now set to open in late March
item.description: The Sharon Lake improvement project, which has been underway for two years, was originally expected to wrap up in late February. Officials now say the lake area will not reopen until late March.
